name: tt-company-formation
description: How to incorporate a company in Trinidad and Tobago in 2026 through the Companies Registry online system and register it with the Inland Revenue Division. Gives the steps (Companies Registry Account, name search and reservation for TT$25 held 45 days, consent by directors and incorporators, Articles of Incorporation for TT$520, certificate collection), then the BIR file number, PAYE, health surcharge, VAT above TT$600,000 and NIS registrations. Trigger on Trinidad company formation, incorporate in Trinidad, Companies Registry Trinidad, registry account, BIR number company. Built from the Registrar General and IRD pages; not reviewed by an accountant.
